note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after d64411a639 and 08bfef9ee7). Section 8: "This document further updates [RFC4306] to require that if all of the encryption algorithms in any proposal are authenticated encryption algorithms, then the proposal MUST NOT propose any integrity transforms." espProposalWire now resolves through lookupESPEncryption; the AEAD decision and the omission of Transform Type 3 are unchanged, and null is non-AEAD (EncryptionNull in the IsAEAD false arm), so a null proposal keeps its integrity transform as RFC 4303 Section 3.2 needs. The four tagged units (IKE and ESP proposals, both polarities) pass at HEAD; records re-taken in 08bfef9ee7. Verdict stands.
